text:
```yaml
name: Pre-Checkout Cleanup

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: pre-checkout-cleanup-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  cleanup:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64]
    steps:
      - name: Pre-Checkout Cleanup
        run: |
          echo "Starting pre-checkout cleanup..."
          # Remove Rust build artifacts
          rm -rf target
          # Remove any node_modules (if present)
          rm -rf node_modules
          # Remove any local cache directories
          rm -rf .cache
          echo "Pre-checkout cleanup completed."
        shell: bash
        if: always()

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
```
